changes.comment: ai-assist: a new descriptor list, IAiProviderDescriptor.samplingParamsRejectedWithThinkingModelPrefixes (queried with the new rejectsSamplingParamsWithThinking), declares models that restrict temperature only while they reason, reusing samplingParamsAcceptedTemperature. OpenAI lists gpt-6-luna (the base tier, @openai:mini): temperature 1 is now sent beside any reasoning effort (it was refused as the thinking/temperature conflict), any temperature is still sent with effort 'none', and any other value with thinking on, including a call with no effort (luna defaults to medium), is refused before the wire on the completion, streaming and client-tool paths with "does not accept a non-default temperature (x) while reasoning: remove temperature, send 1, or set effort 'none'" (with no effort it used to reach the provider and come back a 400). Whether thinking is off is read from the wire the descriptor speaks — on the OpenAI format the effort the adapter sends, openAiEffort ?? xaiEffort — and a verbatim 'other' block that sets that wire's effort key (reasoning_effort, reasoning) decides, since it is merged last. So the only requests whose outcome changes are on gpt-6-luna: a temperature other than 1 whose wire effort is not 'none' (no effort, a typed effort, or an 'other' block's effort overriding a generic 'none') — which the provider 400s — is now refused locally, and temperature 1 beside a typed effort, previously refused, is now sent; a request whose 'other' block sends effort 'none' is sent exactly as before. The "set effort 'none'" hint is offered only where 'none' would turn thinking off (not on a thinking-required model or a Gemini level model).
